m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You dare to storm into my office? Fitzhume told you to stop. You what? You confronted an Agent of the Cabal? Alone? I feel... shocked.
Hmm. She lives on Firecat Alley and has the initials "G" and "D"... Aha! Of course! It makes perfect sense - Gretta Darkkettle.
Quickly! Before she discovers her cover has been blown, the two of you must go to Firecat Alley and question Gretta Darkkettle!
